name: firewall-loss
purpose: Withdraw all data links of the dc1 firewall and pause its guest before a cold reset. The dc2 firewall must take over the VRRP address, and dc1 must take it back after power returns. The streams between hosts cross no firewall and must continue; the pings to the VRRP address may stop only while the address moves.
